images.title: Checking a rectangle
images.purpose: Show the two checks for a rectangle: opposite sides equal and every corner a right angle.
images.composition: One rectangle ABCD centred, with side marks on the sides and corner marks inside.
images.exact_structure: One rectangle ABCD with A top left, B top right, C bottom right, D bottom left; DC and AB each 5 cm drawn teal #0072B2 with one tick mark each, AD and BC each about 4.9 cm drawn amber #E69F00 with two tick marks each. A small square mark in each of the 4 corners. Exactly 1 rectangle, 2 single ticks, 2 double ticks, 4 corner marks.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Check opposite sides in pairs and every corner.
images.description: Rectangle ABCD with opposite sides of 5 cm in teal and about 4.9 cm in amber marked equal, and a right angle mark at each corner.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at each pair of sides, then each corner, as the two checks.

image_decisions.why: Two checks on one finished rectangle make one clear picture.
